items.name: Home server
items.title: Add 32 GB of real swap?
items.question: Add 32 GB of real swap on the SSD as a safety net?
items.summary: Your PC only swaps to compressed RAM, so when that fills there is nothing behind it. A swap file on the SSD is used only after that.
